Name: Hazazon-tamar
Description: The place where the great multitude from beyond the sea was reported to Jehoshaphat, which the text itself explains is En-gedi — the oasis town on the Dead Sea's western shore, here under its older name.
BiblicalSignificance: The verse itself gives the identification — “Hazazon-tamar, which is En-gedi” — so this entry rests on Scripture's own equation, and the report from Hazazon-tamar is what sent Jehoshaphat to seek the LORD.
